text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I'm on my way to deliver an application
to the
director when...

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Thank you all for coming out to see our
show! ♪

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Thank youuu! This performance is still
just getting
started, so stick around and
listen, okay?!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Oh hey, Trainer! If you're free, why don't
you
check out our show?

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
You may have seen me sing and dance
before,
but it feels totally different out
here, right?

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Yeah! And this your one and only chance
to see
the Falco Teio duo perform! ♪

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
I'm just standing in for someone, so this
special
concert is today only!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Yay!
choice_data_list: 数曲だけ見ていこうかな
用事があるからごめん
choice_data_list_en: Maybe I'll stay for just a couple of songs.
Sorry, I've got something to take care of.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Okay, stand over there! That's the best
angle to
see me from!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Feast your eyes! Not only am I an
amazing
Umamusume, but I'm also an
amazing Umadol!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: Hey! I'm amazing too, you know!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: Love, love! ☆ Kiss! ☆ Love, kiss, kiss! ☆

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Yay! Love, love! ☆

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Their performance is fantastic and the
audience is
enthralled.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Dancing and singing for an audience
makes for
great practice for Tokai Teio.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
That was amazing! ♪ They all seemed to
love it!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Yeah! That was so fun! If you ever need
someone
to sub in again, I'm ready!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: For sure, for sure!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Hey, if you want, you could also join us
as an
Umadol—

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: Huh? Teio? Teio, where'd you go?!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Before she could hear Smart Falcon's
proposal,
Tokai Teio spots Symboli
Rudolf and darts off
after her.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Whaaat?!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
You're not gonna watch me?! It's my first
Umadol
concert, though!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Booo! What's more important? Me or
paperwork?!
choice_data_list: 理事長室に申請書を出しにいかないと
choice_data_list_en: I need to go submit the application to the Chairwoman's office.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Come on, Teio. We're doing this for our
fans,
remember?

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Ugh, fine. But don't come crawling back
to me
when you regret it!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I only meant to deliver the documents,
but I end
up chatting for a while.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
After Tazuna sees me off, I leave the
director's
office and...

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Ta-da! It's me!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Yeah! I really wanted you to see my
Umadol
performance!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
I had my friend record the concert! That
way we
can both watch!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Don't forget to give me a bunch of
compliments
after! ♪

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I watch her street concert and flood her
with
praise.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Dancing and singing for an audience
makes for
great practice for Tokai Teio.
